entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For returns or exchanges, please press 2. Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Isaac, I need to return this helmet I bought. I've been on hold forever and I'm losing my patience. Just get me a return label now.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I have your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
It's a VIP account under david.chen@email.com. Look it up. The order was about a month ago, maybe more. I want my money back.

Thank you, Mr. Chen. I see your account and I'm pulling up your recent order for the V-Pro Aero helmet. To make sure I'm processing this correctly, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
A preference? The issue is the color is completely wrong! It looked metallic silver online, and this is just flat gray. It’s been sitting in the closet, the box is unopened! I'm not wearing it.
I understand your frustration with the color not meeting your expectations, Mr. Chen. I'm just checking the return eligibility now... I see the delivery date was 36 days ago.
Thirty-six days? So what? Are you telling me I'm stuck with it? This is unacceptable! I'm a loyal customer! Get me your manager, right now! I'll be sure to leave a review about this.
Sir, please give me just one moment to review our full policy. I assure you we want to find a solution. Your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities at VeloFit.
Okay, thank you for your patience, Mr. Chen. I've just confirmed that your helmet is unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you immediately.
Oh. Ninety days? Well... why didn't you just say that from the start? Fine. Good. Send me the label.

Of course. And for the trouble and the incorrect color representation on our website, I'd like to sincerely apologize. As a valued VIP member, I've also added a $25 credit to your account and ensured your next order will have complimentary expedited shipping. We want to make sure you get the right gear.
Okay. A credit and free shipping? That's better. I appreciate that, Isaac. Just make sure that email comes through quickly.

I'm sending the prepaid return label to david.chen@email.com as we speak. You should see it in the next few minutes. Once we receive the unopened box with the helmet, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mr. Chen?
You're very welcome. Thank you for being a VeloFit customer, and have a great day.
